name: Category Nav
summary: Horizontal scrollable pill-style blog category filter.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Content-width items with a responsive touch target.

states.name: itemFocus
states.description: Visible keyboard focus for category items.

states.name: currentItem
states.description: Existing visual treatment for a target-supplied current category.

behavior.name: targetCategories
behavior.description: The target supplies category labels, counts, destinations, and current state; navigation versus in-place filtering remains unresolved.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Accessible name for the category navigation region.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Target-owned category links or controls, counts, and current-state markup.

accessibility: Use a nav landmark with an accessible label that distinguishes blog categories from other page navigation.
Use aria-current only when items are links and the target represents the current category page; do not apply it to an unresolved filtering model.
Preserve horizontal keyboard access, visible focus, and touch-sized items without hiding content behind clipping.

web.notes: Visual CSS is implemented; navigation versus filter behavior is target-owned pending a source decision.
